description: READ ... PREVIOUS (keyed sequential read in reverse), ISO §2023:14.9.30 Format 1 — introduced 2002
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard); rows 29/108 gate the after-OPEN behavior
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RP.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmrp" ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC RELATIVE KEY IS W-K.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-K PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN I-O F.
    READ F PREVIOUS AT END DISPLAY "E".
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.
